text: いまは　パソコンつうしんで　どうぐや　ポケモンを　データにして　おくれるんだと

structure.jp: どうぐや　ポケモンを　データにして
structure.en: turning items and Pokémon into data
you can send them, I hear

patterns.name: 〜にする
patterns.explanation: A thing plus にする means to turn something into that thing; the て-form links it to the next action. データにして = 'turn them into data and...'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing おくる to おくれる turns 'send' into 'can send'. おくれるんだ = 'you can send them'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と at the very end, with 'they say' left unsaid, shows this is something the speaker heard from others. おくれるんだと = 'you can send them, so I hear'.
